lines: a fictional campaign on Guerrilla.Abel, one engine run, 12903 s of game time (Day 1, 07:30 to 11:05)

occupier-forces at c688fa9 (round 5: e130e2a the band once per frame, honest strike and top-up lines; c688fa9 the stall rule), built in build/agent67-rwdi, on the Remaster shadow of6, stock Guerrilla.Abel at forcesDifficulty Normal (poolStart 48). Two towns taken and held by their garrisons.

Levers (resistance side only): forcesLog on (a diagnostic); the player and his companion invulnerable in the north-western hills; Arudy (four fighters) and Sainte Marie (six) set to garrison 0 and support 55 and held to the end by invulnerable fighters kept within 120 m, magazines topped up every 300 s; a rising at 100 min: both generated outposts, Chapoi and Cancon raided by invulnerable cells that leave once each falls; time x8, x4 while a force is live. No director key tuned. The same scenario as video 6. One tri run, --retries 0 -j1, strict mode, 1905 s wall.
cards.voice: Operation Stone Lantern, run two: the same scenario as video six, on the build that fixed its five findings. Two towns are taken and held by real garrisons; every occupier move is the engine's own.

cues.text: The same scenario as video six, on the round five build. Four fighters take Arudy and stay; the first town's forty percent roll does not answer.
cues.line: [9 s] CounterAttack: Arudy rose; the occupier does not answer (chance 0.40, 0 town(s) taken before)

cues.text: Six take Sainte Marie and stay. The second town wakes the director, with a pool of forty-eight.
cues.line: [193 s] OccupierForces: AWAKE after 2 distinct towns (Sainte Marie the latest), 2 token(s)

cues.text: The first two trucks are beaten the same way as before: three of four riflemen fall, the last one breaks off, the truck follows him home.
cues.line: [615 s] CounterAttack: [op 2] Broken off at Arudy: 3 lost, 1 going home (born 4, alive 1; rule: living infantry below a third of the strength born, the target still held); on foot toward Vigny Outpost; the hulls wait for it to clear 250 m (at most 120 s), 2817 m from the player

cues.text: Arudy is re-armed and the ladder buys a truck with a tank: twenty-one units, and the band drops to stretched.
cues.line: [2343 s] OccupierForces: [op 3] the repel ladder on Arudy (1 repel(s)): lethality 21.60 needed, at least 8 infantry   [2343 s] OccupierForces: band STRONG -> STRETCHED (pool 27 of 48; strength 27: 0 committed in the air, 6 lost and 3 repaid in the last 1.0 h)

cues.text: No base can spare twelve men for Sainte Marie, so the director masses for three ticks.
cues.line: [2703 s] OccupierForces: massing for Sainte Marie: need 12 infantry, best source spares 6 (the token is held, tick 1 of 3)

cues.text: Then a BMP and a T72 go anyway. One band line: stretched to thin, pool four. Video six wrote two lines here in one second; the band now steps once per frame.
cues.line: [2884 s] OccupierForces: [op 4] APC (6, BMP) with T72 from Le Port Harbour to Sainte Marie (34 unit(s), the pool pays 28, lethality 25.50 of 32.40, 6 fighter(s) reported, short of the required lethality: the most lethal affordable package, road 393 s)   [2884 s] OccupierForces: band STRETCHED -> THIN (pool 4 of 48; strength 4: 0 committed in the air, 6 lost and 6 repaid in the last 1.0 h)

cues.text: Arudy beats the tank column: six dead, two walk home. Second rung: a different source, or the air.
cues.line: [3178 s] CounterAttack: [op 3] Broken off at Arudy: 6 lost, 2 going home (born 8, alive 2; rule: living infantry below a third of the strength born, the target still held); on foot toward Airfield; the hulls wait for it to clear 250 m (at most 120 s), 2801 m from the player

cues.text: A helicopter insertion with an attack helicopter strike on top. The strike line now names the band its rule tested: the pool stays stretched, sixteen of forty-eight.
cues.line: [5466 s] OccupierForces: [op 5] the repel ladder on Arudy (2 repel(s)): lethality 21.60 needed, at least 8 infantry; a different approach: by air instead of TRUCK from Airfield   [5466 s] OccupierForces: [op 6] escalation strike: Arudy repelled 2 time(s), the pool stays STRETCHED (pool 16 of 48)

cues.text: Third repel: Arudy is contained, and the Vigny Outpost is surged by six instead.
cues.line: [5802 s] OccupierForces: Arudy: third repel (TRANSPORT_HELI from Airfield), contained: no more attacks on it; Vigny Outpost surged by 6 (the containment lifts when its reports decay, a wave fires or control changes band)

cues.text: Sainte Marie repels six men by helicopter and is contained too; La Riviere Outpost is surged by eight.
cues.line: [6025 s] OccupierForces: Sainte Marie: third repel (TRANSPORT_HELI from Le Port Harbour), contained: no more attacks on it; La Riviere Outpost surged by 8 (the containment lifts when its reports decay, a wave fires or control changes band)

cues.text: The scripted rising takes both generated outposts, Chapoi and Cancon. Control falls to seventy-two percent and both containments lift.
cues.line: [6247 s] OccupierForces: Arudy: containment lifted: control 0.72 crossed a wave threshold (band 0 -> 1) (3 repel(s) remembered)

cues.text: Wave one is called: thirty bodies, ten minutes out.
cues.line: [6307 s] OccupierForces: Wave 1 (30) inbound to Airfield, control 0.72 (control threshold; lands in 600 s)

cues.text: The wave's strike budget reads fifteen, but its one strike costs twenty-one: twelve for the helicopter and its crew, nine staged men. Nothing of the wave stays in the pool.
cues.line: [6907 s] OccupierForces: Wave 1: strikes on the cluster around Arudy (1 target(s), up to 15)   [6907 s] OccupierForces: [op 10] Wave 1 strike: Town retake (package 9, Mi17) from Airfield on Arudy (21 unit(s), the pool pays 12 and stages the infantry, lethality 11.25 of 10.80, 3 fighter(s) reported, line 72 s)

cues.text: Arudy repels the wave strike, seven dead, and is contained again.
cues.line: [7270 s] CounterAttack: [op 10] Broken off at Arudy: 7 lost, 2 going home (born 9, alive 2; rule: living infantry below a third of the strength born, the target still held); on foot toward Airfield, 2762 m from the player

cues.text: The new stall rule fires for the first time: a truck stuck two hundred and ninety-five metres from the Vigny Outpost lets its men out after forty-five seconds.
cues.line: [7281 s] CounterAttack: [op 9] the Ural carrying the force on Vigny Outpost made no progress for 45 s, 295 m out: the infantry gets out where it stands and assaults from there

cues.text: Sainte Marie's fourth attack: nine men in a truck with a tank, across country from the Outpost, the attack that stalled in video six.
cues.line: [8048 s] OccupierForces: [op 13] the repel ladder on Sainte Marie (3 repel(s)): lethality 32.40 needed, at least 12 infantry; a different approach: TRUCK from Outpost instead of TRANSPORT_HELI from Le Port Harbour

cues.text: The truck is born at the same spot, two hundred and ninety-seven metres out, and again it does not move.
cues.line: [8485 s] CounterAttack: [op 13] born for Sainte Marie (spawnReason route) at [5770, 4429], 5302 m from the player

cues.text: After forty-five seconds the stall rule puts the nine men out where they stand, and they assault the town.
cues.line: [8531 s] CounterAttack: [op 13] the Ural carrying the force on Sainte Marie made no progress for 45 s, 297 m out: the infantry gets out where it stands and assaults from there

cues.text: Seven fall and two break off, inside four minutes instead of twenty-seven. Contained again.
cues.line: [8698 s] CounterAttack: [op 13] Broken off at Sainte Marie: 7 lost, 2 going home (born 9, alive 2; rule: living infantry below a third of the strength born, the target still held); on foot toward Outpost; the hulls wait for it to clear 250 m (at most 120 s), 5424 m from the player

cues.text: Arudy's locals, silent since the strike, never report it again, so its containment decays and push-outs come back with no fighter reported.
cues.line: [9069 s] OccupierForces: Arudy: containment lifted: its reports decayed (4 repel(s) remembered)

cues.text: The wave's two-man column finally arrives, and its line now says where the two went: to the pool, in the wave headroom.
cues.line: [11987 s] OccupierForces: [op 11] Le Port Harbour reinforced: 0 joined its garrison; 0 back at Airfield, 2 to the pool (pool 50 of 48, 2 over poolStart in the wave headroom)

cues.text: Three and a half hours: seventy-four occupiers lost, eleven operations on the two towns, both still held.
cues.line: [12902 s] scenario note: end: pool 47 of 48, band STRONG, tokens 2, operation counter 16, waves fired 1, control 0.942857, lost 74, repels [["Arudy",6,"TRUCK","Outpost",true],["Sainte Marie",4,"TRUCK","Outpost",true]]

7.1 and 16 say strikes take 'up to 0.5 of the wave'; the share counts staged infantry only (6.5 puts hull and crew on the pool), so the one strike took 21 of the 30-unit wave against 'up to 15' (video 6: 18). A wording fix or a code change
190 / 475 WARN (sound, texture, config), 0 ERRR, none from the director

Every video 6 finding is fixed, and nothing else in the run contradicts the docs. One low item: 7.1 and 16 describe the wave strike share in units, the code counts infantry. Fix that wording or the code and the loop can stop.

outro_voice: All five findings of video six are fixed: the stuck truck now lets its men out, the band steps once, and the lines say what the rule tested. One low item is left: the wave's strike share counts only infantry, so its strike spent twenty-one of thirty units while the plan says half. Settle that wording, and the loop can stop.
